categories.note: What kind of object it is

items.t: Mock film poster. Overlapping hero cluster, largest figure lower centre, the others fanned around, {4} in a bottom corner.
Mock gig poster. Three inks, bold flat shapes, a short hand lettered line of dates for extremely boring venues.
Mock magazine cover. The three of them mid laugh, a masthead, no more than two cover lines.
Mock album cover. Square, figure dense, all three crammed onto a small sofa.
Mock recruitment poster for the care team. All three mid task in a kitchen doing three unrelated things.
Mock public information notice. Deadpan official layout, entirely unhinged content, all three demonstrating the wrong procedure.
Mock cereal box front. Bold flat shapes, invented brand name, ridiculous product claims, {4} as an unauthorised endorsement.
Mock board game box lid. All three gathered around a chaotic tabletop, invented game title.
Mock instruction diagram. Line art only, an exploded view of a normal Tuesday, numbered steps, one step going obviously wrong.
Mock expedition photograph. Ordinary clothes, absurd location, treated as a routine shift, hand lettered banner.
Single comic splash panel. One moment, ink outlines, flat colour.
Four panel strip laid out on one canvas as a single composition, same cast throughout.
Character sheet, four by four cells on one canvas, each cell a different pose and expression, plain background.
Flat lay from directly overhead, objects arranged in a neat ninety degree grid, one cluster of belongings per member of the cast.
Circular group avatar. Head and shoulders bust, all four squeezed in, overlapping at different heights, plain background, everything safe inside a centred circle.
Four character cards sharing one frame design and colour scheme, each showing one character in a characteristic pose, a name banner only, the lower area filled with a small illustrated prop.
Mock natural history plate. The three of them and the cat presented as specimens of the domestic sofa habitat, plain hand lettered name tags only.
